# The when phrase runs a translate command the CLI document does not declare yet: translate LANGUAGE,
# exit 0 with the translated greeting logged. Ask the System Architect to confirm, then add both.
architecture:
  services:
  - name: greeter
    path: services/greeter
    language: go
    public_interface:
      kind: cli
      document: docs/greeter-cli.yaml
  phrases:
  - template: the greeting is configured
    service: greeter
    references:
    - file: greeting-config
    does: Write the expected greeting to the configuration file before running greet.
  - template: 'the greeting is translated into "{language}"'
    service: greeter
    references:
    - command: translate
    does: Run the translate command with the named language to translate the configured
      greeting once.
  - template: the greeting is logged
    service: greeter
    references:
    - log_record: greeted
    does: Observe the greeted log record and compare its greeting to the expected
      text.

opencli: 1.0.0
info:
  title: Greeter
  version: 1.0.0
commands:
  greet:
    parameters:
    - name: person
      in: argument
      required: true
      schema:
        type: string
    - name: loud
      in: flag
      schema:
        type: boolean
    responses:
      '0':
        description: Greeting printed
      '1':
        description: Invalid input
  translate:
    parameters:
    - name: language
      in: argument
      required: true
      schema:
        type: string
    responses:
      '0':
        description: Translated greeting printed
      '1':
        description: Invalid input
extensions:
  files:
    greeting-config:
      path: greeter.yaml
      format: YAML mapping with a greeting string
      access: read
  log_records:
    greeted:
      message: Greeting printed
      format: logfmt with person and greeting fields
  outgoing_calls:
    notify:
      command: notifier
      arguments:
      - --person
      - '{person}'
